body:
Adds `research/outer-momentum` (companion to `local-sgd-bias`): in DiLoCo-style training, H inner steps make the outer optimiser see curvatures 1−(1−ηa)^H, so the outer condition number shrinks from κ to about κ/H. Includes exact per-mode rates checked against literal simulation, the heavy-ball optimum (every mode at √β*), optimal momentum falling from 0.88 to 0.01 as H grows (a fixed 0.7/0.9 Nesterov needs 4–8× more rounds), and the wallclock-optimal sync interval H* ≈ C.

- 9 unit tests, experiments/results.txt, whitepaper
- README bullet and site/projects.json entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok (99 projects, 920 tests)
